notes.title: V1.11 Minor Hotfix Patch
notes.content: [h3]Feature Adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]“Return to Main Menu (without saving)”[/b] button to the Settings screen.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed missing localized translations on the Achievements screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing characters (glyphs) in some languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Democratic side could incorrectly display Trump’s portrait at the start of a round.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential soft-lock at the start of a round.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock that occurred when a discard-card effect was triggered but the affected faction had no cards in hand.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]Feature Adjustments:[/h2][list][*][p]Added a special endgame newspaper.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a prominent visual effect when taking control of a state.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fullscreen mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added language support for Arabic, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Italian, Polish, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Turkish.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI now prefers to contest states where both sides have invested heavily.[/p][/*][*][p]Further AI tuning to make it smarter.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed cards appearing misaligned after changing screen resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause a card to enter your hand face-down.[/p][/*][*][p]When converting an extra card to money in the Propaganda slot, undo now correctly returns the card to the player’s hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Spending extra money to obtain a card in the Policy slot now deducts money correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI now correctly spends money when playing cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, on the Voting screen, the AI’s use of an opponent-faction card did not apply its points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where AI-applied card effects failed to take effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect UI feedback during AI actions.[/p][/*][/list]
